title: Update the new system prompt (snippets.ts) to teach Gemini CLI what a subagent is

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable request to update the system prompt in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts to teach Gemini CLI what a subagent is and how to use subagents.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Modifying text prompt snippets in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts is a straightforward system prompt/documentation update requiring minimal logic changes and standard prompt test updates, taking less than 1 day.

summary.problem: The system prompt in snippets.ts lacks an explicit definition and comprehensive instructions for Gemini CLI on what a subagent is and how to use them.
summary.root_cause: The renderSubAgents function in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts needs updated text content to clearly define subagents and explain their usage guidelines to the model.
summary.context: Subagents enable strategic delegation and context compression in Gemini CLI. Clear system prompt definitions guide the agent on when and how to delegate tasks effectively.

steps: Locate the renderSubAgents function in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts.
Update the prompt content within renderSubAgents to include a clear definition of what a subagent is.
Provide explicit instructions on when and how Gemini CLI should utilize subagents for task delegation.
Ensure prompt formatting, variables, and markdown tags remain well-formed.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: renderSubAgents produces updated system prompt text containing the subagent definition and operational instructions.
verification_steps: Run unit tests with Vitest on packages/core/src/prompts/utils.test.ts.
Verify that the prompt output generated by renderSubAgents includes the expected definition and usage rules for subagents.
